answer_2.quote: We measure the performances under cross-sentence task. We report Word Error Rate (WER) and speaker Similarity between generated and the original target speeches (SIM-o) for objective evaluation... We also report Real-Time Factor (RTF) and UTMOS scores.

answer_4.quote: We use Comparative Mean Opinion Scores (CMOS) and Similarity Mean Opinion Scores (SMOS) for subjective evaluation... Details of subjective evaluations can be found in Appendix C.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters were asked to rate the naturalness of the generated speech (CMOS) and the similarity to the reference speaker (SMOS).
